docs.summary: Turns one kind of source file into assets at runtime, for a [`SourceAssetBackend`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.SourceAssetBackend). Register your own with [`Register`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.RuntimeImporters~Register) to load a format the engine does not know.
The file extensions this importer reads, with the dot, such as ".png".
The type of the file's main asset.
Builds the file's main asset, and any sub assets, through `context`. Runs on the asset loader thread.
